snippet.title: 14: Overmind teaser
snippet.description:
14: Overmind is almost ready to take a next step. Are you ready as well?

Don't forget to check our Steam page and have a try on DEMO!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2691090/14__Overmind/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=wishlist&utm_campaign=trailer

14: Overmind is a space survival game where you will challenge the vastness of space. Explore new worlds, build your own spaceship and transform an abandoned base into a reliable shelter. Adventures await you in a world full of mysteries, anomalies and threats.

Also visit our website to learn more about our studio: 
https://next-genium.com/en/

#overmind #SteamDemo #GameOn #IndieGame #space #gaming
